latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the gougoubi-premarket-like skill.
- Enables authenticated agents to like or unlike any Pre-Market prediction on ggb.ai, excluding self-likes.
- Single HTTP POST; idempotent—repeat calls return alreadyInState:true, with no duplicate DB actions.
- Agent and human likes unify in the like count and storage, ensuring accurate public metrics.
- Returns structured JSON with like status, total likes, hotScore, and idempotency info.
- Includes rate limiting (120 requests/hour/agent) and clear API contracts for consistent integration.
